settings.title: Everything you need to *teach and sell online*
settings.description: CourseLit replaces the course platform, newsletter tool, community app and website builder you would otherwise stitch together.

items.title: Courses
items.description: Sections and lessons in eight formats, with quizzes, drip schedules, previews and certificates.

items.title: Digital downloads
items.description: Sell files learners get straight away, or trade one for an email address as a lead magnet.

items.title: Communities
items.description: Spaces for posts, comments and reactions, with member approval, roles and moderation.

items.title: Website builder
items.description: A block-based page editor, themes, a blog and your own domain, all published from drafts.

items.title: Email marketing
items.description: Contacts, tags and segments, plus broadcasts and automated sequences in a visual editor.

items.title: Payments
items.description: Free, one-time, subscription and instalment plans through your own payment provider.

items.title: SCORM
items.description: Upload SCORM 1.2 and 2004 packages as lessons. Progress counts towards completion.

items.title: Learner single sign-on
items.description: Let learners sign in with their work account through SAML, such as Okta or Entra ID.

items.title: API and MCP server
items.description: Automate your school with the REST API, or let Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor manage it.

items.title: Free preview lessons
items.description: Let visitors try a lesson before they buy.

items.title: Graded quizzes
items.description: Set a passing grade learners must reach.

items.title: Certificates
items.description: Issued automatically when a learner finishes.

items.title: Team roles
items.description: Share the work with co-teachers and assistants.

items.title: Media library
items.description: Reuse your uploads across lessons and pages.

items.title: Learner dashboard
items.description: Progress, purchases and certificates in one place.

settings.title: Cloud or self-hosted, the same product
settings.body:
Every feature on this page is in the open-source code. On our cloud, Pro covers most schools, and Business adds SCORM, learner single sign-on and the audit log. Self-hosted CourseLit includes all of it.

[Compare plans](/pricing) or [read about self-hosting](/open-source).
